archive_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the archive file (e.g., .tar.gz, .zip, .7z)

mount_point.description: Absolute path to the mount point directory

options.description: List of archivemount-specific FUSE options; each item is a string option or key=value pair (e.g., 'ro', 'subtree=man', 'password', 'nosave', 'nobackup', 'formatraw')
